raw.one_liner: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to automate and scale their AI operations.
raw.thesis:
Narma is building an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies. The core innovation lies in its three-layered architecture: an Observe layer with lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns, an Intelligence Layer that acts as a "Brain" to detect employee intent, business value, and workflow drift, and an Execution Layer or "Agent Factory" that automatically generates and deploys AI agents for high-ROI opportunities. This system aims to provide a continuous AI lift by observing work, deciding AI actions, and continuously building agents.

The venture is for AI-first companies that need to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale. The problem Narma addresses is the common struggle among enterprises with a lack of telemetry for AI savings, unreliable ROI measurements, and constant drift in systems and human resources.

The founder's goal, while not explicitly stated as a lifestyle, growth, or moonshot business, can be inferred as a growth-oriented startup given the focus on enterprise AI automation at scale and continuous AI lift. The venture appears to be at the idea stage, as no artifacts or signals of development were mentioned.

Narma positions itself as a foundational replacement for existing, fragmented approaches to AI automation. Instead of piecemeal solutions for observation, intelligence, or execution, Narma integrates all three functions into a single system. This makes it a core platform that companies would rely on for their entire AI automation strategy, rather than a complementary tool. It aims to precede other AI solutions by establishing the infrastructure for continuous AI deployment and optimization.
raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma integrates the entire cycle of AI automation – observation, intelligence, and execution – into a single, continuous system for enterprises, ensuring a "Continuous AI lift."
